title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（郭清蓮研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Guo Qinglian)
educationalGoal:
Students will:
（1）	Learn how to investigate previous projection mapping studies.
（2）	Learn how to design projection mapping content.
（3）	Learn how to create projection mapping content.
（4）	Learn how to design interactive projection mapping games.
（5）	Learn how to carry out a projection mapping event.
advice:
Students are required to have knowledge about basic computer graphics algorithms.
Students are required to have programming skills with Processing or Unity.
Students are expected to be able to use Blender, Photoshop, and AfterEffect.
requiredKnowledge: The ability to perform programming with C or Java is required.

              Students will:
（1）	Learn how to investigate previous projection mapping studies.
（2）	Learn how to design projection mapping content.
（3）	Learn how to create projection mapping content.
（4）	Learn how to design interactive projection mapping games.
（5）	Learn how to carry out a projection mapping event.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students are required to have knowledge about basic computer graphics algorithms.
Students are required to have programming skills with Processing or Unity.
Students are expected to be able to use Blender, Photoshop, and AfterEffect.
